name: Sidebar
hint: Collapse it with [ or the panel button, then hover the icons: labels slide out beside them.
description: App sidebar that takes your navigation: groups, one nested level, badges, a header slot (workspace switcher) and a footer slot (account). It collapses to an icon rail where labels slide out as flyouts beside the hovered or focused icon; with peek on, resting on the rail opens the full sidebar over the content. The active marker glides between items, even while a group expands underneath it. On phones it becomes an off-canvas drawer you open and close.
usage: Use for apps with five or more top-level destinations. Pass `items` (groups { id, label, items } of { id, label, icon, href, badge, children, disabled }), mark the current page with `currentHref` (your router's path) or `value` + `onChange`, and pass `renderLink` so your router's Link handles clicks. Put your workspace switcher in `header` and the account block in `footer`. Layout: it fills its parent's height, so put it first in a flex row with a set height (height:100dvh, the main area flex:1; min-width:0; overflow:auto), or give it position:sticky; top:0; height:100dvh when the window scrolls. Below `drawerBelow` px it takes no width and becomes a drawer: render your own menu button and own the drawer with `open` + `onOpenChange`. Remember `collapsed` per user with `onCollapsedChange`.
